clue.text: In her case, he'd terribly bad luck!

indicators.note: terribly suggests these words are badly mangled, so their letters are rearranged

parts.note: the apostrophe adds no letter

explanation.surface: Commiserating with a woman whose legal case has gone badly for him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terribly' rearranges HER CASE HED; 'In' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A British idiom, usually ironic, for misfortune or tough luck.

clue.text: Tramp found in fairy ring

parts.note: a hob is a sprite or goblin, as in hobgoblin
a ring is round like the letter O

explanation.surface: A vagrant discovered sitting in a circle of mushrooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name a homeless wanderer; synonym.

clue.text: Judges' successor showing mercy

definitions.meaning: in the Bible the book following Judges
an old word for pity or compassion

explanation.surface: A new judge who shows clemency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Judges' looks like court officials, but it is the Old Testament book.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical book placed after Judges, and an archaic noun for compassion, as in ruthless.

clue.text: Colour television showing sort of picture that's over-sentimental

parts.note: chocolate is a dark brown colour
the box is slang for television

explanation.surface: A colour TV set showing a soppy image.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom for twee prettiness, from the pretty scenes printed on sweet packaging.

clue.text: Female characters surrounding M, so to speak

indicators.note: the two letters are written as they are pronounced when spoken

parts.note: in the alphabet L comes before M and N after it

explanation.surface: Women in a story gathered around the spymaster M.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so to speak' spells out L and N as spoken, EL and EN.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's given name, so a female.

clue.text: Has dinner cooked for assembled lawmakers

indicators.note: cooked means prepared or doctored, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dinner party prepared for a group of legislators.
explanation.definitionFit: The supreme council and court of ancient Israel, which made and interpreted law.

clue.text: Make incisive attack in essay

definitions.meaning: an attempt, as in have a go

explanation.surface: Writing a cutting critique in a school essay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essay' is not a composition but an old word for an attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: A knife thrust, and a try or attempt at something.

clue.text: A trifle — sample about one bottle with it

indicators.note: about means the sampling word is placed around the other pieces

parts.note: to sample is to try
one is the Roman numeral I
a vial is a small bottle
taken as written

explanation.surface: Tasting a little dessert and a bottle with it.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean an unimportant matter; synonym.

clue.text: Coping with supporters

parts.note: coping is the top course of a wall; here it rests on a row of small columns

explanation.surface: Someone managing thanks to friends who back them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coping' looks like managing, but it is the capping on a wall or parapet.
explanation.definitionFit: A railing made of a row of small posts topped with a rail, as along a staircase.

clue.text: Essential factor behind policy

parts.note: the behind is the buttocks
a line is a policy, as in the party line

explanation.surface: The key element behind a government policy.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for the fundamental point or result.

clue.text: Misfortune with Jack for her

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for jack in playing cards
an ill is a misfortune

explanation.surface: Bad luck goes with Jack for his companion.
explanation.walkthrough: The nursery rhyme pairs Jack with his companion who went up the hill.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, the female partner in the rhyme, so the pronoun stands in for it.

clue.text: Unofficially, it could be hard for defector

indicators.note: signals the letters could be rearranged into something else

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard on pencils

explanation.surface: Speaking privately, life could be tough for a defector.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it could be' rearranges H (hard) with FOR and DEFECTOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for remarks not to be quoted publicly.

clue.text: Fakes reform of secret unit

indicators.note: to reform is to shape again, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Forgeries made by restructuring a covert squad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reform' rearranges OF SECRET UNIT; 'of' is fodder, not a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are forged imitations; plural noun synonym.

clue.text: As a rebel. I trick 15. finally

parts.note: taken as written
a con is a swindle or trick
15 across is a commander; OC stands for Officer Commanding
last means finally

explanation.surface: A rebel boasting of how he duped a senior officer in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: '15' points to the answer at 15 across, a commander, abbreviated OC. 'As' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An attacker of established beliefs or institutions is a kind of rebel.

clue.text: I appear on time with American musical works

parts.note: I appear means I am here, shortened to I'm
prompt means punctual

explanation.surface: A performer arriving punctually with American music.
explanation.definitionFit: Short free-form instrumental pieces suggesting improvisation, as by Schubert.

clue.text: Naval officer bringing Butterfly to bad end? Right

parts.note: the comma is a British butterfly with comma-shaped markings

indicators.note: bad suggests the word is spoilt, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An officer bringing Madame Butterfly to a tragic close.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butterfly' suggests the opera, but it is the comma butterfly. 'bad' rearranges END into NDE.
explanation.definitionFit: A rank in the Royal Navy just below captain.

clue.text: Carry out analysis of French fashion

parts.note: de is French for of
to fashion is to compose or create

explanation.surface: Analysing what makes French fashion work.
explanation.definitionFit: To break something into its component parts, which is analysis.

clue.text: West End bank rebuffed revolting character

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter
rebuffed means pushed back, so the word is turned backwards

parts.note: to bank on is to rely on

explanation.surface: A London theatre-district bank turning away a disgusting customer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'West End' looks like London's theatre district; 'rebuffed' turns RELY into YLER. Wat Tyler led the English Peasants' Revolt of 1381.
explanation.definitionFit: Wat Tyler was a rebel leader, a pun on revolting as in revolt.

clue.text: Sauce bottle

explanation.surface: A bottle of ketchup.
explanation.definitionFit: Impudent cheek, and courage or daring; both colloquial senses.

clue.text: Arranged for players to study teaching qualification

parts.note: to con is to study or learn
Cert Ed is the British Certificate in Education

explanation.surface: Musicians arranging to study for a teaching certificate.
explanation.definitionFit: Music arranged in parts for several performers, as in a concerted piece.

clue.text: In which you'll find widespread German money, and French?

definitions.text: In which you'll find widespread German money, and French?

parts.note: common means widespread
the mark was Germany's currency
et is French for and

explanation.surface: Where German and French money are shared widely.
explanation.walkthrough: The old European Economic Community, where both Germany and France were members.
explanation.definitionFit: The former name of the European trading bloc that included Germany and France.

clue.text: Libertines' inclinations

definitions.meaning: possessive of plural libertines, dissolute men
slopes, as of a stage or roof

explanation.surface: The tendencies of dissolute men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inclinations' looks like leanings of character, but it means slopes.
explanation.definitionFit: Dissolute pleasure-seekers, and angles of slope.

clue.text: Surrender capital, none the less

indicators.note: the less means minus, so a letter is taken away

parts.note: Quito is the capital of Ecuador
none is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Giving up a capital city all the same.
explanation.walkthrough: 'none the less' looks like a single phrase but splits into 'none' (O) and 'the less'.
explanation.definitionFit: To give up or abandon; synonym.

clue.text: It's for maid's or matron's head

definitions.text: It's for maid's or matron's head

parts.words: It's for maid's or matron's head
parts.note: a treatment of curls given to any woman's hair

explanation.surface: Something meant for the head of a servant or a matron.
explanation.definitionFit: A permanent wave, a curling treatment for hair.

clue.text: Wine tasting section

indicators.note: section means a part cut out of the word tasting

explanation.surface: A wine tasting event.
explanation.definitionFit: A sparkling Italian wine from Piedmont.

clue.text: What conscientious monarchs or bolshie employees do

definitions.text: What conscientious monarchs or bolshie employees do

parts.words: What conscientious monarchs or bolshie employees do
parts.note: a dutiful king governs diligently, while awkward workers obey regulations to the letter as protest

explanation.surface: Comparing dutiful kings with stroppy staff.
explanation.walkthrough: Bolshie is British slang for awkward; this phrase names a protest of following rules exactly to slow work.
explanation.definitionFit: An industrial protest by literal compliance, and literally a monarch's duty of reigning.

clue.text: Work a critic takes one to

definitions.meaning: to take someone to this is to rebuke them

explanation.surface: A job a reviewer brings someone along to.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom 'take to task' means to scold.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of work to be done, and the idiom for scolding someone.

clue.text: Used TA's men in order to provide an element of experience

indicators.note: in order suggests the letters are put into a new sequence

parts.note: TA's apostrophe adds no letter

explanation.surface: Employing Territorial Army soldiers for a training exercise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' rearranges USEDTASMEN; TA is Britain's Territorial Army, the reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A philosophical term for an immediate unanalysed sensation, the raw element of perception.
